parts: JCH.E., JCH.P., CH. BIG-FOOT DE THALEK JOY OF MY LIFE
CAMPEÓN EN PORTUGAL DE BELLEZA, GRAN CAMPEÓN DE PORTUGAL, BEAUTY GIBRALTAR CHAMPION
Toasted brown and white male born on October 27, 2011.
Father identified by DNA in Real Sociedad Canina de España.

Born of the mated of our beautiful boy Ch. Universal Beauty (Chicho) with our first girl Clear Spring (Yazmine) daughter of our Champion Amistad Sincera (Miss) joining important American bloodlines in his pedigree.
He is now living with our friend Jessica in A Coruña. We appreciate your trust in us, in our Shih Tzu and in our way of breeding.
His start in shows could not be better winning Best of Breed Puppy at the International Dog Show of Madrid 2012 (obligatory point).
We expect and hope that his career in the shows to be successful.
